cmd.mgr.open_big.desc: Opens a large model file in the background. Pick a file; loading progress shows in a separate window.
cmd.mgr.mesh_cache.desc: Imported mesh cache: shared shapes and simplified copies for fast 3D.
cmd.site.toposolid.desc: Creates a toposolid from points with elevations. Click points in the plan, Enter builds the surface.
cmd.site.toposolid_import.desc: Creates a toposolid from a survey points file. Pick the file and check the units.
cmd.site.boundary.desc: Sets the toposolid boundary. Draw the outline in the plan; the surface is trimmed to it.
cmd.site.subregion.desc: Marks a sub-region with its own material on the toposolid: grass, asphalt, gravel. Draw its outline in the plan.
cmd.site.pad.desc: Cuts a building pad into the toposolid at a set elevation. Draw the pad outline in the plan.
cmd.site.smooth.desc: Smooths the toposolid inside a region. Draw the region in the plan; point elevations inside are averaged.
cmd.site.flatten.desc: Flattens the toposolid inside a region to one elevation. Draw the region and enter the elevation.
cmd.site.edit_points.desc: Edits toposolid points: drag them in the plan and vertically in 3D, or type an elevation.
cmd.site.contours.desc: Shows or hides toposolid contour lines in the plan.
cmd.site.properties.desc: Site and toposolid properties of the project.
cmd.str.truss.desc: Places a truss: click the start and end of the bottom chord.
cmd.str.footing_all.desc: Places footings under every column that has none yet.
cmd.arch.roof_gable.desc: Turns the selected roof into a gable roof. Select a roof first.
cmd.arch.roof_hip.desc: Turns the selected roof into a hip roof with slopes on every side. Select a roof first.
cmd.arch.roof_shed.desc: Turns the selected roof into a shed roof. Select a roof first.
cmd.arch.roof_mansard.desc: Turns the selected roof into a mansard roof with broken slopes. Select a roof first.
cmd.arch.roof_gambrel.desc: Turns the selected roof into a gambrel roof: two slopes with a break. Select a roof first.
cmd.arch.roof_barrel.desc: Creates a barrel vault roof: click the span start and end, then the side and depth.
cmd.arch.roof_join.desc: Joins the selected roof to another: click the roof to join to.
cmd.arch.roof_unjoin.desc: Unjoins the selected roof from the roofs joined to it.
cmd.arch.fascia.desc: Adds a fascia along a roof edge. Choose a profile and click the roof edges.
cmd.arch.gutter.desc: Adds a gutter along a roof edge. Choose a profile and click the roof edges.
cmd.arch.soffit.desc: Creates a roof soffit. Choose a profile and the roof edges.
cmd.arch.skylight.desc: Inserts a skylight into a roof. Hover over a slope and click the placement point.
cmd.str.slab_edge.desc: Adds a profile along a floor edge. Choose a profile and click the floor edges.
cmd.arch.wall_sweep.desc: Adds a sweep along a wall at a set height. Choose a profile and click the wall.
cmd.arch.wall_cornice.desc: Adds a cornice along the top of a wall. Choose a profile and click the wall.
cmd.arch.wall_reveal.desc: Cuts a reveal into a wall along a profile at a set height. Choose a profile and click the wall.
cmd.arch.roof_taper.desc: Creates tapered insulation sloping to drains: click drain points, Esc finishes.
cmd.arch.roof_edges.desc: Lists the project roof edge and sweep elements: select, edit properties, delete.
cmd.arch.sweep_profiles.desc: Profile library for edges and sweeps: create and edit profiles.
cmd.view.home_3d.desc: Returns the 3D view to the home camera position.
cmd.view.zoom_sel_3d.desc: Zooms the 3D view to the selected elements.
cmd.view.projection.desc: Switches the 3D view between perspective and orthographic projection.
cmd.view.walk.desc: Walk and fly through the model: WASD to move, mouse to look, G to fly, Esc to exit.
cmd.view.style_consistent.desc: 3D visual style: consistent colors without shading.
cmd.view.style_hidden.desc: 3D visual style: hidden line, white faces and black edges.
cmd.view.style_wireframe.desc: 3D visual style: edges only, faces are transparent.
cmd.view.style_xray.desc: 3D visual style: translucent faces that reveal inner elements.
cmd.view.vg_3d.desc: Category visibility and color in the 3D view. Tick the categories to show.
cmd.view.section_box_fit.desc: Turns on a section box around the selected elements. Drag the box faces to move them.
cmd.view.section_plane.desc: Cuts the 3D view with a plane facing the camera through the selection or the model. Drag its arrow to move it; run again to turn it off.
cmd.view.section_caps.desc: Turns the cut fill on the section box faces on or off.
cmd.view.level_3d.desc: Opens a 3D view of the current level with a section box over its height.
cmd.view.save_3d.desc: Saves the current 3D view with camera, section box and style. Enter a view name.
cmd.view.hide_cat_3d.desc: Temporarily hides the category of the selected element in 3D. The view is not changed.
cmd.view.isolate_cat_3d.desc: Temporarily shows only the category of the selected element in 3D.
cmd.view.reveal_3d.desc: Brings back every temporarily hidden category in 3D.
cmd.view.orbit_center.desc: Turns the orbit drag around the centre of the model instead of the point under the cursor, so the model stays in view.
cmd.view.orbit_auto.desc: The camera circles the model by itself, for presentations. Run it again to stop.
